Contract ManageLibrarianCRUDService::createLibrarian(librarianid: String,name: String,password: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		librarianId: String,
		name: String,
		password: String
	precondition:
		let obs: Librarian = Librarian.allInstance()->select(o|o.LibrarianID = librarianId) in
		obs.isEmpty()
	postcondition:
		let ob: Librarian in
		ob.oclIsNew() and
		Librarian.allInstance()->includes(ob) and
		ob.LibrarianID = librarianId and
		ob.Name = name and
		ob.Password = password and
		result = true
}
